method: Asset composition (Python/Pillow/pycairo) of native character, card, tower, workshop and Architect art with a faithful port of the approved opus.js Verdigris Armillary; no image generation, no body cracks.

candidates.title: The Architect's Duel
candidates.description: The requested duel: a warm-lit normal Ironclad faces a mirrored Corrupted Silent wrapped in the Opus armillary, each with their own native card fan underneath, while a dimmed, lilac-rimmed Architect looms between them in the dark workshop under a centered ACT 4 / ECHOES OF THE PAST title.

candidates.title: Mirror Match
candidates.description: A symmetrical split-sky poster at the Architect's tower: the Defect in warm sunset light on the left faces its own armillary-bound Corrupted echo in plum duotone on the right, divided by a lilac seam, with the tagline YOUR PAST IS THE FINAL BOSS. above and the title below.

candidates.title: Your Move
candidates.description: First-person framing: the viewer's native Ironclad hand spans the foreground as their own Corrupted Ironclad in the armillary steps up on the tower approach, with the Architect waiting beside the tower and a left-aligned title block with the tagline.
